- `rm export_debug.log tmp_export_3.csv` → blocked.
- `mkdir -p archive && mv export_debug.log tmp_export_3.csv archive/` → blocked.

**Next steps (if allowed):**
- An administrator could temporarily disable the Patton gate or approve the deletion of the two scratch files, after which I could remove them and finalize the cleanup.
